summary: Frontend-only redesign verification for UNIQUE Detailing. All 23 service pages under /uslugi/<slug> return 200 and render with their bespoke sections (#about, #fit, #process, #examples, #faq, #zapis) and a valid hero image with naturalWidth>0. /uslugi hub loads with 11 images, 0 broken. Mega-menu opens, showing 54 service links across 8 directions. FAQ accordion (native <details>) opens on click. Booking form (LeadForm) renders 9 fields (name, phone, email, car, service, comment, website honeypot, 2 required consent checkboxes) with submit button 'Отправить заявку'; empty submit triggers native HTML5 validation on 4 required inputs (correct — actual Supabase submit is a mocked/placeholder integration and was not required to succeed). Palette section is present on smena-cveta-poliuretan and smena-cveta-vinil, and correctly absent on stilevaya-vinilografiya. Mobile 390px hero for PPF renders readable (headline, facts row, in-page nav all visible). All hero images files exist under public/generated/<slug>/hero.jpg. First-pass rate-limit (Cloudflare 429) hit 17/23 pages due to rapid sequential navigation — retested with delays and all 17 loaded cleanly (heroLoaded=true, sections=[T,T,T,T,T,T]).
action_items: None blocking. Optional: consider adding data-testid on hero, facts row, in-page nav, FAQ triggers and LeadForm submit to make future automated testing more robust (currently only semantic ids/roles are available).
Optional: Cloudflare rate-limits rapid crawls of the preview URL; consider whitelisting the automation IP or increasing rate limits for testing.
critical_code_review_comments: No functional issues found in the redesign scope. Public preview is behind Cloudflare which briefly returned 429 on rapid navigation — this is infra, not app.
Booking form submission target (Supabase) uses placeholder keys in preview per spec — verified render + client-side (HTML5 required) validation only; do NOT interpret submission failure as a bug.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (23/23 pages, hub, mega-menu, FAQ, form validation, palette)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL is behind Cloudflare — add >=2s between page.goto() calls to avoid 429. All 23 slugs load with hero + all 6 in-page sections. FAQ uses native <details>/<summary>; open state check via 'details[open]'. LeadForm fields: name (required), phone (required), email, car, service, comment, website (honeypot), 2 required consent checkboxes. Palette present only on smena-cveta-poliuretan and smena-cveta-vinil.
